title.vi: Số lần đo CH₄ hợp lệ mỗi ô 1,1 km, 2019–2025
title.en: Valid CH₄ looks per 1.1 km cell, 2019–2025

provenance.source: Copernicus Sentinel-5P TROPOMI OFFL L3 (contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data)
provenance.method: OFFL L3 XCH4 bias corrected, all daily images 2019-2025; looks counted and XCH4 averaged on the ~1.1 km L3 grid (EE asset), XCH4 kept where >= 10 looks, then mean of the 1.1 km cells to ~10 km
